entities.summary: Kwabena Appiah-Pinkrah is a consultant and Ghanaian politician of the Republic of Ghana. He is the Member of Parliament representing Akrofoum constituency of the Ashanti Region of Ghana in the 4th,5th,6th and 7th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana. He is a member of the New Patriotic Party. Kwabena Appiah-Pinkrah was a intelligence & espionage from Ghana (b. 1947-08-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
